title: Hand-crank egg-beater task suite
goal: Verify both beater outputs, their opposed motion, and the approved crank-to-beater speed increase from one shared crank cycle.

profiles.title: Three-to-one dual-output egg beater
profiles.description: The approved two-beater profile derived from hand_crank_egg_beater_v1.

scenarios.title: Shared hand-crank cycle
execution_requirements: Execute one crank cycle and derive all four task results from the same input and output traces.
Apply torque only to the authored crank input; neither beater output may be directly actuated.
Use continuous unwrapped shaft angles for rotation and ratio evaluation.
Derive expected direction signs from the frozen axis bindings rather than treating a global negative sign as a family-wide constant.

tasks.title: Rotate the left beater through one revolution
tasks.goal: Drive the left beater through at least one complete continuous revolution.

criteria.description: The left beater accumulates one full revolution, allowing 0.1 rad numerical shortfall.

failure_diagnostics.description: The left output did not complete the accepted continuous rotation.
The left output trace was wrapped or otherwise insufficient for continuous-angle evaluation.

evidence_obligations: Report the left output's continuous accumulated angle from the shared cycle.
Preserve physical and ideal-reference left-shaft traces.

tasks.title: Rotate the right beater through one revolution
tasks.goal: Drive the right beater through at least one complete continuous revolution.

criteria.description: The right beater accumulates one full revolution, allowing 0.1 rad numerical shortfall.

failure_diagnostics.description: The right output did not complete the accepted continuous rotation.
The right output trace was wrapped or otherwise insufficient for continuous-angle evaluation.

evidence_obligations: Report the right output's continuous accumulated angle from the shared cycle.
Preserve physical and ideal-reference right-shaft traces.

tasks.title: Counter-rotate the two beaters
tasks.goal: Verify that the two output beaters rotate in opposite directions at equal speed magnitude.

criteria.description: The frozen-axis output traces have opposite physical rotation directions.
The two output angular-speed magnitudes have a 1:1 ratio within five percent.

failure_diagnostics.description: The two beater outputs did not rotate in opposite frozen-axis directions.
The output speed magnitudes differed by more than the approved tolerance.

evidence_obligations: Show both signed output traces and the frozen axis-direction bindings.
Compute the magnitude ratio over the driven interval rather than from a single endpoint.

tasks.title: Increase beater speed from the crank
tasks.goal: Verify a three-to-one beater-to-crank angular-speed magnitude ratio with direction interpreted from the frozen axes.

criteria.description: The beater-to-crank angular-speed magnitude ratio is 3:1 within five percent.
The measured crank-to-beater direction agrees with the sign derived from the frozen axis bindings.

failure_diagnostics.description: The beater-to-crank speed magnitude ratio was outside the approved range.
The measured direction was inconsistent with the frozen input and output axis definitions.

evidence_obligations: Report crank and beater signed traces together with their axis bindings.
Evaluate the speed ratio over the driven interval and preserve both physical and ideal-reference results.

source_projects.note: The source project supplied certified dual-output and ratio evidence; the user approved a one-revolution minimum with 0.1 rad shortfall and five-percent ratio tolerances for this task suite.

approval.basis: The user approved grouping all four egg-beater checks into one crank-cycle suite and explicitly requested approximately one full revolution from both beaters.
